author: opencode-worker-2
text: Worker-2 analysis (released): the GNSS_L76K driver and DTS binding don't exist on my branch (beads-worker-2). The sxvf parent created them on another branch. My branch has the NMEA validation suite (lichen/tests/nmea_l76k) from ak84. The build validation needs: (1) the L76K driver files (gnss_l76k.c, Kconfig, DTS binding) from sxvf to be merged first; (2) the STACK_CANARIES choice warning fixed (gnss_emul prj.conf sets CONFIG_STACK_CANARIES=y as a choice, but it's a bool — fix is to remove it and let the Zephyr default resolve, or use CONFIG_STACK_CANARIES=y in a board fragment); (3) MODEM_BACKEND_UART dependency satisfied on native_sim (needs CONFIG_MODEM_MODULES=y + CONFIG_MODEM_BACKEND_UART=y). Releasing — needs the sxvf driver files merged first, then a fresh worker can fix the gnss_emul prj.conf and validate.
